{{Quote|Those missile tanks are deadly. Take 'em down, Rhys!|[[Bravo Twelve]] to Rhys Dallows|<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />}}
The '''AMT''' was an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] employed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|First Battle of Lok]] and the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Star Wars: Starfighter'' refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> It was particularly effective against air units, carrying 2 [[Missile/Legends|missile]] launchers.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Ten AMTs were deployed by the Trade Federation against Naboo [[Naboo Resistance|forces]] during [[Mission in the Naboo canyon|the attempt]] to destroy a [[Naboo Resistance base|resistance base]] located in the [[Naboo training canyon]]. Five AMTs were destroyed by the pilot [[Rhys Dallows]], of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] as he escorted the ''[[Zoomer]]'' through the canyon, and the other five were destroyed when Dallows found his escorts.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
AMTs appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. They are also mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|game's strategy guide]]. The player, in the role of Rhys Dallows, is not required to take out all seven tanks in the mission, only those threatening the escorts. Doing so completes a bonus objective, rewarding the player with one of the missions's medals.
